text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...One night toward the end of the summer 
training camp.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. I smell so many different kinds of 
food.
choice_data_list: Yeah. It really feels like a festival.
Yeah. It's got a real festival vibe, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lucky Lilac and I had come to enjoy a 
festival near the training camp.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's get some food before 
looking around. Is there anything that 
catches your eye, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Sounds lovely. Maybe I'll have the same 
thing as well.
choice_data_list:
Let's go with extra veggies and extra 
ginger!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ......Hoho. Trainer-san, that ain't ramen~

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Somehow, this year's summer training 
camp went by in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Well, maybe that just means it's been 
that fulfilling, but still—"
choice_data_list:
Unlike last year, you've trained your 
hardest, after all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That's true. Last year she had a sudden 
growth spurt and ankle swelling, so we had 
to take things easy.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"The younger generation, like Loves-chan 
and the others, really are quite 
something."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Those girls grew by leaps and bounds this 
summer... Looks like expectations are 
really high, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Compared to that, do you think I've grown 
properly?"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
From the time I entered the Senior Year 
until today... I've properly—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
More graceful, more magnificent. Her 
running, and her heart, grew ever 
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having watched by her side throughout the 
days leading up to today, I realize that 
more keenly than anyone.
choice_data_list:
It really feels like getting extra 
everything!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ramen, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right. Even the sharpness of this 
comeback.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief. That wasn't the time to 
play the fool, ya know.
choice_data_list: Haha, sorry. But I'm not lying.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She endured, she strove, and the fact that 
she grew in every single aspect is an 
undeniable truth.
choice_data_list:
You will become a "Queen" more glamorous 
than anyone else!

You will become a "Queen" more brilliant 
than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
......My, you certainly have a silver 
tongue.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Autumn approaches.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The decisive autumn where Lucky Lilac 
would be reborn as 'Queen'.
